sources.note: Main website. Describes BMW Platform as integrated medical workflow software for procedure centers, surgery centers, and specialty clinics. Lists target markets and core modules.

ONC certification and mandatory disclosures page. Lists certified criteria, product version 10.5.1.1, certification date, module names (BT Inventory, BT Monitor, BT PACS, BT RIS, BT Scheduler). Notes additional fee for e-prescription license.

About page. Founded 2004 in Texas, headquartered in Corpus Christi. Two business units: Braintree Products (software sales) and Braintree Operations (IT and billing management). Also operates under NephroPACS name.

BMW Platform overview. Describes the platform as intranet web-based medical workflow software combining RIS, PACS, EMR, ERP (inventory/supply chain), and Practice Analysis into one package. DICOM, HIPAA, and HL7 compliant.
Why Braintree page. Lists target settings: hospitals, outpatient centers, vascular, pain management, ASCs, imaging, cath labs, orthopedic, specialty clinics. No customer testimonials or case studies.

Vascular centers page. Describes exam-driven workflow from pre-scheduling through billing. Mentions access flow history, pre/intra/post-op data, imaging, inventory, safety incidents. Interfaces with Transonic, Vasc-Alert, HL7, DICOM. Referral portal for physician image access.

Hospital solutions page. Describes admissions, scheduling, clinical documentation, imaging integration, inventory management, and billing with auto-coded procedures. Lists BT Inventory, BT Monitor, BT PACS, BT RIS, BT Scheduler modules.

Typical workflow scenario. Six-step workflow: scheduling, admission, during procedure (vitals, supplies, CPT codes, dictation), post-procedure (auto billing code update, inventory deduction), recovery (physician review with images/notes), billing (same-day completion).
BT PACS page. Picture Archive Communication System with image acquisition, archiving, compression/backup, display, and routing. FDA-approved viewer. Attaches images to patient EMR.
BT Monitor page. System monitoring tool for EMR/PM servers, network infrastructure, disk/memory/CPU, and facility temperature. Sends email/text/IM alerts. Archives log files.
BT Inventory page. Real-time supply tracking on per-procedure basis. Manages stock quantities, low-stock alerts, purchase orders, and spending data.
BT Scheduler page. Multi-doctor, multi-hospital appointment scheduling. Electronic calendar with daily/weekly/monthly views. Integrates with EMR and PACS worklists.
BT RIS page. Radiology Information System for radiology procedure data, patient scheduling, tracking, results reporting, and film tracking. Web-based, integrates with BT PACS.
Practice Analysis page. Business analytics covering procedure volumes vs charges, referral trends, staff productivity, wait times, receivables/payment cycles. Customizable performance indicators.
NephroPACS domain — redirects to braintreehealth.com. Confirms NephroPACS is an alias/subsidiary of Braintree Health. TLS certificate error on direct access.
Home page. Highlights ambulatory certified EHR, target markets (vascular, surgical, pain, imaging, cath labs, orthopedic, behavioral health, hospitals, MSO/ACO, chronic care management).
